title: transport
summary: MSUI parses the transport wire tolerantly but discards it: the GameObject create-block anchor (path-progress u32) is read and dropped (UpdateObject.cs:80), and observed movers' MOVEFLAG_ONTRANSPORT local-pose tails are read and dropped in the LIVING parse (UpdateObject.cs:49). MovementInfo.cs can carry a TransportPose for the self-player, but no timetable or keyframe evaluation exists anywhere - no TaxiPathNode/TransportAnimation loading, no per-frame cycle sampling.

openItems.text: Type-15 MO_TRANSPORT boats/zeppelins never move: no TaxiPathNode.dbc timetable build from the template's (taxiPathId, moveSpeed, accelRate) tuple, no (anchor + elapsed) % period sampling - a streamed boat renders frozen at its create pose (if rendered at all).
Type-11 TRANSPORT elevators/lifts never move: no TransportAnimation.dbc keyframe path keyed by template entry, no spawn-quat composed sampling.

Observed riders are not carried: the on-transport local pose from create blocks and MSG_MOVE_* relays is discarded, so a deck NPC or fellow passenger renders at a stale world pose instead of being composed through the transport's live matrix.
No dock/depart behavior, no off-map hiding of a transport sailing another continent's leg.
